<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function() {

    var c = this;


    /* =========================================
       DASHBOARD
       ========================================= */

    c.dashboard = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "?id=cfms_staff";

    };


    /* =========================================
       ASSIGNED TICKETS
       ========================================= */

    c.assignedTickets = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "?id=cfms_assigned";

    };


    /* =========================================
       LOGOUT
       ========================================= */

    c.logout = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "/logout.do";

    };

};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================
   CFMS STAFF HOME
   ========================================= */

.cfms-staff-page {
    min-height: 100vh;

    background: #f0fbfc;

    color: #263238;

    font-family:
        "Segoe UI",
        Tahoma,
        Geneva,
        Verdana,
        sans-serif;
}


/* HEADER */

.staff-header {
    height: 72px;

    background: #00acc1;

    color: white;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    padding: 0 35px;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.staff-brand {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 12px;
}


.brand-icon {
    width: 43px;
    height: 43px;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 22px;
}


.staff-brand h2 {
    margin: 0;

    font-size: 23px;
}


.staff-brand span {
    font-size: 11px;

    opacity: .9;
}


/* USER */

.staff-user {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 10px;
}


.user-avatar {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;
}


.user-info {
    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;
}


.user-info strong {
    font-size: 14px;
}


.user-info span {
    font-size: 11px;

    opacity: .85;
}


.logout-btn {
    margin-left: 15px;

    padding: 8px 13px;

    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);

    background: transparent;

    color: white;

    border-radius: 6px;

    cursor: pointer;
}


.logout-btn:hover {
    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;
}


/* LAYOUT */

.staff-layout {
    display: flex;

    min-height: calc(100vh - 72px);
}


/* SIDEBAR */

.staff-sidebar {
    width: 235px;

    flex-shrink: 0;

    background: white;

    border-right: 1px solid #dceff1;

    padding: 25px 15px;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.sidebar-title {
    padding: 0 12px 15px;

    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 11px;

    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 1px;
}


.sidebar-item {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 13px;

    padding: 13px 14px;

    margin-bottom: 5px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    color: #546e7a !important;

    text-decoration: none !important;

    cursor: pointer;

    position: relative;
}


.sidebar-item:hover,
.sidebar-item.active {
    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1 !important;
}


.sidebar-item i {
    width: 20px;

    text-align: center;
}


.menu-count {
    margin-left: auto;

    min-width: 20px;

    height: 20px;

    padding: 0 5px;

    box-sizing: border-box;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #00acc1;

    color: white;

    font-size: 10px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;
}


.sidebar-divider {
    height: 1px;

    background: #e5eeee;

    margin: 20px 10px;
}


/* MAIN */

.staff-content {
    flex: 1;

    padding: 35px 45px;

    max-width: 1400px;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}


/* WELCOME */

.welcome-section {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    margin-bottom: 30px;
}


.page-label {
    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 11px;

    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 1px;
}


.welcome-section h1 {
    margin: 7px 0;

    font-size: 31px;
}


.welcome-section p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #607d8b;

    font-size: 14px;
}


.tickets-btn {
    padding: 13px 20px;

    background: #00acc1;

    border: none;

    border-radius: 8px;

    color: white;

    font-weight: 600;

    cursor: pointer;
}


.tickets-btn:hover {
    background: #008fa1;
}


/* STATS */

.stats-grid {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 18px;

    margin-bottom: 35px;
}


.stat-card {
    background: white;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;

    border-radius: 12px;

    padding: 20px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 15px;

    box-shadow:
        0 3px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}


.stat-icon {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 21px;
}


.stat-icon.teal {
    background: #e0f7fa;
    color: #00acc1;
}


.stat-icon.orange {
    background: #fff3e0;
    color: #fb8c00;
}


.stat-icon.blue {
    background: #e3f2fd;
    color: #1976d2;
}


.stat-icon.green {
    background: #e8f5e9;
    color: #43a047;
}


.stat-card span {
    display: block;

    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 12px;
}


.stat-card strong {
    display: block;

    margin-top: 3px;

    font-size: 25px;
}


/* SECTIONS */

.dashboard-section {
    margin-bottom: 35px;
}


.section-heading {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    margin-bottom: 18px;
}


.section-heading h2 {
    margin: 0 0 5px;

    font-size: 21px;
}


.section-heading p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 13px;
}


/* ACTIONS */

.action-grid {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 18px;
}


.action-card {
    background: white;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;

    border-radius: 13px;

    padding: 24px;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition: .25s ease;
}


.action-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);

    box-shadow:
        0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.08);

    border-color: #b2ebf2;
}


.action-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    margin-bottom: 15px;

    font-size: 20px;
}


.teal-bg {
    background: #e0f7fa;
    color: #00acc1;
}


.blue-bg {
    background: #e3f2fd;
    color: #1976d2;
}


.green-bg {
    background: #e8f5e9;
    color: #43a047;
}


.red-bg {
    background: #ffebee;
    color: #e53935;
}


.action-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;

    font-size: 17px;
}


.action-card p {
    min-height: 42px;

    margin: 0 0 15px;

    color: #607d8b;

    font-size: 13px;

    line-height: 1.6;
}


.action-card span {
    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 12px;

    font-weight: 600;
}


/* PRIORITY */

.priority-grid {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 15px;
}


.priority-card {
    background: white;

    border-radius: 10px;

    padding: 17px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 13px;

    border-left: 4px solid;
}


.priority-card.critical {
    border-left-color: #e53935;
}


.priority-card.high {
    border-left-color: #fb8c00;
}


.priority-card.medium {
    border-left-color: #f9a825;
}


.priority-card.low {
    border-left-color: #43a047;
}


.priority-number {
    font-size: 25px;

    font-weight: 700;
}


.priority-card strong {
    display: block;

    font-size: 13px;
}


.priority-card span {
    display: block;

    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 10px;
}


/* TICKETS */

.view-all-btn {
    background: transparent;

    border: none;

    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: 600;

    cursor: pointer;
}


.ticket-list {
    background: white;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;

    border-radius: 13px;

    overflow: hidden;
}


.ticket-row {
    min-height: 65px;

    padding: 12px 20px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 14px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #edf3f4;
}


.ticket-row:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}


.ticket-icon {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;
}


.ticket-info {
    flex: 1;

    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 3px;

    min-width: 0;
}


.ticket-info strong {
    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 13px;
}


.ticket-info span {
    color: #607d8b;

    font-size: 12px;

    white-space: nowrap;

    overflow: hidden;

    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}


/* BADGES */

.status-badge,
.priority-badge {
    padding: 5px 9px;

    border-radius: 15px;

    font-size: 10px;

    font-weight: 600;

    white-space: nowrap;
}


.status-active {
    background: #fff8e1;

    color: #f57f17;
}


.status-progress {
    background: #e3f2fd;

    color: #1976d2;
}


.status-resolved {
    background: #e8f5e9;

    color: #2e7d32;
}


.priority-critical {
    background: #ffebee;

    color: #c62828;
}


.priority-high {
    background: #fff3e0;

    color: #ef6c00;
}


.priority-medium {
    background: #fff8e1;

    color: #f9a825;
}


.priority-low {
    background: #e8f5e9;

    color: #388e3c;
}


/* EMPTY */

.empty-state {
    background: white;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;

    border-radius: 13px;

    padding: 45px 20px;

    text-align: center;
}


.empty-icon {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;

    margin: 0 auto 15px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #e8f5e9;

    color: #43a047;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 25px;
}


.empty-state h3 {
    margin: 0 0 7px;
}


.empty-state p {
    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 13px;
}


/* RESPONSIVE */

@media (max-width: 1100px) {

    .stats-grid,
    .action-grid,
    .priority-grid {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

}


@media (max-width: 800px) {

    .staff-sidebar {
        width: 70px;

        padding: 20px 8px;
    }

    .sidebar-title,
    .sidebar-item span {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar-item {
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .staff-content {
        padding: 25px;
    }

}


@media (max-width: 600px) {

    .staff-header {
        padding: 15px 18px;
    }

    .staff-brand span,
    .user-info {
        display: none;
    }

    .welcome-section {
        flex-direction: column;

        align-items: flex-start;

        gap: 18px;
    }

    .tickets-btn {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .stats-grid,
    .action-grid,
    .priority-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .ticket-row {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .staff-content {
        padding: 20px 15px;
    }

}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>cfms_staff_dashboard</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
  
}]]></link><name>CFMS Staff Dashboard</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

    /* =========================================
       DEFAULT DATA
       ========================================= */

    data.userName = gs.getUserDisplayName();

    data.assignedCount = 0;

    data.openCount = 0;

    data.inProgressCount = 0;

    data.resolvedCount = 0;

    data.criticalCount = 0;

    data.highCount = 0;

    data.mediumCount = 0;

    data.lowCount = 0;

    data.recentTickets = [];

    data.error = "";


    /* =========================================
       LOGIN CHECK
       ========================================= */

    if (!gs.isLoggedIn()) {

        data.redirect = "cfms_login";

        return;
    }


    /* =========================================
       STAFF ROLE CHECK
       ========================================= */

    if (!gs.hasRole("cfms_staff") &&
        !gs.hasRole("admin")) {

        data.redirect = "cfms_home";

        return;
    }


    /* =========================================
       GET ASSIGNED TICKETS
       ========================================= */

    var gr =
        new GlideRecord("incident");


    /*
     * Assigned directly to current staff
     */

    var assignedQuery =
        gr.addQuery(
            "assigned_to",
            gs.getUserID()
        );


    gr.orderByDesc("sys_updated_on");

    gr.query();


    while (gr.next()) {

        data.assignedCount++;


        /* =====================================
           STATE
           ===================================== */

        var state =
            gr.getValue("state");

        var stateText =
            gr.getDisplayValue("state");


        if (state == "1") {

            data.openCount++;

        }

        else if (state == "2") {

            data.inProgressCount++;

        }

        else if (state == "6" ||
                 state == "7") {

            data.resolvedCount++;

        }

        else {

            data.openCount++;

        }


        /* =====================================
           PRIORITY
           ===================================== */

        var priority =
            gr.getValue("priority");

        var priorityText =
            gr.getDisplayValue("priority");

        var priorityClass =
            "priority-medium";


        if (priority == "1") {

            data.criticalCount++;

            priorityText = "Critical";

            priorityClass =
                "priority-critical";

        }

        else if (priority == "2") {

            data.highCount++;

            priorityText = "High";

            priorityClass =
                "priority-high";

        }

        else if (priority == "3") {

            data.mediumCount++;

            priorityText = "Medium";

            priorityClass =
                "priority-medium";

        }

        else if (priority == "4") {

            data.lowCount++;

            priorityText = "Low";

            priorityClass =
                "priority-low";

        }


        /* =====================================
           STATUS CLASS
           ===================================== */

        var statusClass =
            "status-active";


        if (state == "2") {

            statusClass =
                "status-progress";

        }

        else if (state == "6" ||
                 state == "7") {

            statusClass =
                "status-resolved";

        }


        /* =====================================
           RECENT 5
           ===================================== */

        if (data.recentTickets.length < 5) {

            data.recentTickets.push({

                sys_id:
                    gr.getUniqueValue(),

                number:
                    gr.getValue("number"),

                short_description:
                    gr.getValue(
                        "short_description"
                    ),

                state:
                    stateText,

                stateValue:
                    state,

                statusClass:
                    statusClass,

                priority:
                    priorityText,

                priorityValue:
                    priority,

                priorityClass:
                    priorityClass

            });

        }

    }


})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 11:26:06</sys_created_on><sys_id>bca014d5a0af03107f4432329b8a150f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CFMS Staff Dashboard</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Campus Food Services Assistant" source="x_snc_campus_foo_1">423299d7dd1f03107f44143a6accf8fb</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Campus Food Services Assistant">423299d7dd1f03107f44143a6accf8fb</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_bca014d5a0af03107f4432329b8a150f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 11:26:06</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="cfms-staff-page">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <header class="staff-header">

        <div class="staff-brand">

            <div class="brand-icon">
                <i class="fa fa-cutlery"></i>
            </div>

            <div>
                <h2>CFMS</h2>
                <span>Staff Portal</span>
            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="staff-user">

            <div class="user-avatar">
                <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
            </div>

            <div class="user-info">

                <strong>
                    {{c.data.userName}}
                </strong>

                <span>
                    Food Service Staff
                </span>

            </div>

            <button
                class="logout-btn"
                ng-click="c.logout()">

                <i class="fa fa-sign-out"></i>
                Logout

            </button>

        </div>

    </header>


    <!-- LAYOUT -->
    <div class="staff-layout">


        <!-- SIDEBAR -->
        <aside class="staff-sidebar">

            <div class="sidebar-title">
                STAFF MENU
            </div>


            <a
                class="sidebar-item active"
                ng-click="c.dashboard()">

                <i class="fa fa-dashboard"></i>

                <span>
                    Dashboard
                </span>

            </a>


            <a
                class="sidebar-item"
                ng-click="c.assignedTickets()">

                <i class="fa fa-tasks"></i>

                <span>
                    Assigned Tickets
                </span>

                <span
                    class="menu-count"
                    ng-if="c.data.assignedCount > 0">

                    {{c.data.assignedCount}}

                </span>

            </a>


            <div class="sidebar-divider"></div>


            <a
                class="sidebar-item"
                ng-click="c.logout()">

                <i class="fa fa-sign-out"></i>

                <span>
                    Logout
                </span>

            </a>

        </aside>


        <!-- MAIN -->
        <main class="staff-content">


            <!-- WELCOME -->
            <section class="welcome-section">

                <div>

                    <span class="page-label">
                        STAFF DASHBOARD
                    </span>

                    <h1>
                        Welcome, {{c.data.userName}}
                    </h1>

                    <p>
                        Manage and resolve campus food
                        service requests.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <button
                    class="tickets-btn"
                    ng-click="c.assignedTickets()">

                    <i class="fa fa-tasks"></i>

                    View Assigned Tickets

                </button>

            </section>


            <!-- STATISTICS -->
            <section class="stats-grid">


                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon teal">

                        <i class="fa fa-tasks"></i>

                    </div>

                    <div>

                        <span>
                            Assigned Tickets
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.assignedCount}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon orange">

                        <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>

                    </div>

                    <div>

                        <span>
                            Open Tickets
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.openCount}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon blue">

                        <i class="fa fa-spinner"></i>

                    </div>

                    <div>

                        <span>
                            In Progress
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.inProgressCount}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon green">

                        <i class="fa fa-check-circle"></i>

                    </div>

                    <div>

                        <span>
                            Resolved
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.resolvedCount}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </section>


            <!-- QUICK ACTIONS -->
            <section class="dashboard-section">

                <div class="section-heading">

                    <h2>
                        Staff Actions
                    </h2>

                    <p>
                        Manage food service requests
                    </p>

                </div>


                <div class="action-grid">


                    <!-- ASSIGNED -->
                    <div
                        class="action-card"
                        ng-click="c.assignedTickets()">

                        <div class="action-icon teal-bg">

                            <i class="fa fa-tasks"></i>

                        </div>

                        <h3>
                            Assigned Tickets
                        </h3>

                        <p>
                            View and manage requests
                            assigned to you.
                        </p>

                        <span>
                            Open Tickets
                            <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i>
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <!-- START -->
                    <div
                        class="action-card"
                        ng-click="c.assignedTickets()">

                        <div class="action-icon blue-bg">

                            <i class="fa fa-play"></i>

                        </div>

                        <h3>
                            Start Work
                        </h3>

                        <p>
                            Start working on pending

                            <span>
                                Immediate attention

                    <div class="priority-card high">

                            </strong>

                            <span>
                                Requires attention

                        </div>

                    <div class="priority-card medium">

                    ng-if="c.data.recentTickets.length > 0">

                        class="ticket-row"
                        ng-repeat="ticket in c.data.recentTickets">

                            <i class="fa fa-file-text"></i>

                            <strong>
                                {{ticket.number}}

                            <span>

                        </div>
